title: Balaghat Malaria Outbreak : Baiga community plea to CM Mohan Yadav. #cmmohanyadav #balaghat #adiwasi

systemic_issues: Missing nutrition rations for the vulnerable Baiga community
Consumption of contaminated stream water due to lack of safe drinking infrastructure
ground_truth.community_status: Severe distress, direct appeal to Chief Minister Mohan Yadav for urgent intervention

official_record.sanitation_and_supplies: Unacknowledged or reported as stable, with no official systemic link established between missing food rations, contaminated stream water, and the spike in malaria-related mortality

critical_omissions: Failure to address the breakdown of the public distribution system (nutrition rations) in the tribal belt
Failure to acknowledge that contaminated local streams are the primary drinking water source, compounding immunological vulnerability to malaria
Official suppression of the actual scale of the epidemic within the vulnerable Baiga indigenous community
